svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Atlas Map view (⌥1) as a 3D globe, Landscape L0 (INC-2041)
svg.desc: The Map view at ladder level L0 drawn as a tilted 3D globe. The Earth is a dark sphere with a dot-matrix landmass, hairline graticule, a soft atmosphere rim and its night side dimmed (the Americas west coast and Asia are in darkness at 12:40 UTC). Each region or data centre stands on the surface where it really is, as a raised district of extruded hexagons whose height encodes load; healthy regions are near-monochrome grey. eu-west-1 glows Failing with a magenta ⊕ origin beacon rising off the surface above Ireland (payments → psp-api, INC-2041). Great-circle traffic arcs carry particles between regions; the arc from eu-west-1 up to the external psp-api on the outside-the-estate orbit ring is red because 38% of calls fail. LON-DC2 is a hatched ghost (telemetry stale). Edge chips point to three regions on the far side. A docked 2D strip shows eu-west-1 error rate over the last hour, linked to the selection, with the −7d ghost, the ⚙ 12:19 timeout change and ⚠ 12:22 onset. HUD: top bar, view switcher with Map active, layer chips with Health active, Orbit · Map · Fly chip, altitude ladder with L0 lit, minimap, orbit gizmo, care queue and the Time Ribbon.

g.text: Blast radius: 3 regions see checkout errors
on-prem · 122 hosts blind · collector down 6 min
search p99 1.1 s · owner on it
Origin is a beacon off the surface
⊕ rises radially from eu-west-1, so it
reads from any orbit; glow = anomaly.
Each region is a raised district on
the globe; colour only where health
call path to psp-api on the outside
ring is red where calls fail.
trouble is pinned to the limb chip.
